And His statement, Indeed, those who ask your permission - those are the ones who believe in God and His Messenger, meaning, God the Most High says: Indeed, those who, O Muhammad, if they are with you on a common matter, turn away from you except with your permission, out of obedience to God and to you, and believing in what I have brought them from Me - those are the ones who truly believe in God and His Messenger, not those who disobey the command of God and the command of His Messenger, turning away from you without your permission, after you have preceded them that they not turn away from you except with your permission. And His statement,
h
So when they ask your permission for some of their affairs

, give permission to whomever you wish of them, meaning, for some of their needs that arise to them, then give permission to whomever you wish of them to leave you to fulfill them. And ask forgiveness for them, meaning, and supplicate to God for them to be gracious to them by pardoning them for the consequences of what is between Him and them. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful, for the sins of His repentant servants. Merciful to them, lest He punish them for them after they have repented from it.

x: God Almighty says to the companions of His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: O believers, do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one another. The commentators differed on the meaning of this.

Some of them said: God forbade the believers with this verse from exposing themselves to the Messenger’s supplication against them, and He said to them: Beware of his supplication against you, that you do what angers him, lest he supplicate against you for that reason and you perish. Do not make his supplication like the supplication of any other person, for his supplication is binding.
Who said that?

c: Muhammad bin Saad told me, he said: My father told me, he said: My uncle told me, he said: My father told me, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Abbas,
m: his statement,
h
Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one of you to another
, the calling of the Messenger upon you is binding, so beware of it.

x: Others said: Rather, this is a prohibition from God to call upon the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, with harshness and rudeness, and a command to call upon him with gentleness and humility.
Who said that?

c: Muhammad ibn Amr told me, he said: Abu Asim told us, he said: Isa told us, and Al-Harith told me, he said: Al-Hasan told us, he said: Warqa’ told us
m: both, on the authority of Ibn Abi Nujayh, on the authority of Mujahid, Like the supplication of some of you to others, he said: He commanded them to supplicate: O Messenger of God, with gentleness and humility, and not to turn away: O Muhammad, with a frown.

c: Al-Qasim told us, he said: Al-Hussein told us, he said: Hajjaj told us, on the authority of Ibn Jurayj, on the authority of Mujahid,
m: regarding his statement:
h
Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one of you to another
, he said: He ordered them to call upon him: O Messenger of God, with gentleness and humility.

c: Al-Hasan told us, he said: Abd al-Razzaq told us, he said: Muammar told us, on the authority of Qatada,
m: regarding his statement,
h
Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one of you to another

, he said: He commanded them to magnify and honor him. The first of the two interpretations of this, which is more correct in my opinion, is the interpretation that Ibn Abbas said, and that is that what precedes His saying,
h
Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one of you to another

, is a prohibition from God to the believers, that they should do what He dislikes by turning away from him, in the matter that unites them all, and what comes after it is a threat to those who turn away from him without His permission. So what is between them, that it is a warning to them of His wrath, that He will compel them to call down curses upon them, is more likely than it being a command to them to do something that has not been mentioned, such as glorifying and honoring him with words and supplication. And His statement,
h
God knows those among you who slip away secretly

, means, the Most High says: You who turn away from your Prophet without his permission, concealing and hiding from him. Even if the matter of those among you who do that is hidden from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, God knows that, and nothing is hidden from Him. So let those among you who do that, who disobey God’s command in turning away from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, except with His permission, fear that a trial from God will befall them, or a painful punishment will be inflicted upon them, so that their hearts will be sealed and they will disbelieve in God. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that.

x: Who said that?

c: Ibn Hamid told us: Hakam bin Bashir told us: Amr bin Qais told us, on the authority of Juwaybir, on the authority of Ad-Dahhak,
m: regarding the statement of God,
h
God knows those among you who slip away in secret

, he said: They would hide behind one another, and then they would stand up. So he said: Let those who disobey his command beware, lest a trial befall them. He said: His heart will be sealed, and he will not feel safe from displaying disbelief with his tongue, so his neck will be struck.

c: Al-Qasim told us, he said: Al-Hussein told us, he said: Hajjaj told us, on the authority of Ibn Jurayj, on the authority of Mujahid,
m: regarding his statement,
h
God knows those among you who slip away in secret
. He said: Contrary to what was said.

c: Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us,
m: Ibn Zayd said, regarding the statement, God certainly knows those among you who slip away in secret, he said: These are the hypocrites who return without the permission of the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him). He said: Lawāḥmeans to seek refuge from him and evade, and to go without the permission of the Prophet (blessings and peace of God be upon him). So let those beware who oppose his command who do this lest a trial befall them or a painful punishment befall them. The trial here means disbelief, and Lawāḥis the verbal noun of Lawḥtu bi-fran malawāḥita wa-lawāḥita, and that is why the waw appears. If it were the verbal noun of Dhat, it would have been said Liyāḥ, just as one says, I stood up qiyaam, and when it is said, I resisted you, it is said, a long standing. Lawāḥis that people take refuge with one another, one hiding behind this one, and the other with that one, as Ad-Dahhak said. His statement:
h
Or a painful punishment befalls them
. He says:
h
Or a painful punishment befalls them
in this worldly life from God, for their actions and their disobedience to the command of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. His saying,
h
So let those beware who disobey His command
, and so let those beware be inserted because the meaning of the statement is: So let those beware who turn away from His command and turn away from it, averse.

x: God Almighty says: Behold, God is the King of all the heavens and the earth. He says: It is not appropriate for a slave to disobey the command of his Master and thus deserve His punishment. He says: “The same is true for you, O people. It is not right for you to disobey your Lord who is your Master. So obey Him, and follow His command, and do not turn away from His Messenger if you are with him on a common matter, except with His permission.”
And His statement,
h
He certainly knows what you are doing
, of your obedience to Him in what He has commanded you and forbidden you from, as Yunus also told me, saying:

c: Ibn Wahb told us, saying:
m: Ibn Zayd said, regarding His statement,
h
He certainly knows what you are doing

, this is also your action. And the Day they will be returned to Him, meaning: And the Day those who disobeyed His command will be returned to God, Then He will inform them, meaning: Then He will inform them at that time, of what they did, in this world, when He will reward them for what they did in the past, of their disobedience to their Lord. And God is Knowing of all things, meaning: God has knowledge of everything you and they and others have done, and other matters. Nothing is hidden from Him, rather He encompasses all of that, and He will give every worker among you the reward for his work on the Day you are returned to Him.

notes.en: Al-manāṣiʿ are places where one relieves oneself, urinates, defecates, or attends to a need. Lisān al-ʿArab, root n-ṣ-ʿ.

notes.en: T1 and al-Nasāʾī read “defecating.” Al-tanazzuh means keeping away from rural areas and water sources where there is no water, moisture, or gathering of people. Lisān al-ʿArab, root n-z-h.

notes.en: Al-mirṭ is a wrap made of brocade, wool, or linen; it is also said to mean a green garment. Lisān al-ʿArab, root m-r-ṭ.
notes.ar: المرط: كساء من خز أو صوف أو كتان، وقيل هو الثوب الأخضر. اللسان (م ر ط).

notes.en: “Yā hantāh” means “O woman”; the nūn may be vowelled with fatḥah or left sukūn, and the final hāʾ may be vowelled with ḍammah or left sukūn. It is also said to mean “O foolish woman,” as though she were described as lacking knowledge of people’s schemes and evils. Al-Nihāyah, 5/279–280.
notes.ar: ياهنتاه، أي: يا هذه، وتفتح النون وتسكن، وتضم الهاء الآخرة وتسكن، وقيل: معنى ياهنتاه: يا بلهاء، كأنها نسبت إلى قلة المعرفة بمكايد الناس وشرورهم. النهاية 5/ 279، 280.

notes.en: Yaʿdhirunī means “he would excuse me if I repaid her for her bad conduct, and would not blame me.” Al-Nihāyah, 3/197.

notes.en: Al-jumān are small pearls; it is also said to mean silver beads made to resemble pearls. Al-Nihāyah, 1/301.

notes.en: Tusāminunī means “you vie with me and try to outdo me”; it is a reciprocal form from al-sumū, meaning that you seek to surpass me in his esteem. Al-Nihāyah, 2/405.
notes.ar: تساميني، أي: تعالينى وتفاخرنى، وهو مفاعلة من السمو، أي تطاولنى في الحظوة عنده. النهاية 2/ 405.

notes.en: Al-Nasāʾī in al-Kubrā (no. 11360) reports it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Aʿlā. ʿAbd al-Razzāq in his Muṣannaf (no. 9748), Aḥmad, 6/194 (al-Maymaniyyah edition), Muslim (no. 56/2770), and al-Ṭabarānī, 23/50 (no. 133), report it through Maʿmar.
notes.ar: أخرجه النسائي في الكبرى (11360) عن محمد بن عبد الأعلى به، وأخرجه عبد الرزاق في المصنف (9748)، وأحمد 6/ 194 (الميمنية)، ومسلم (56/ 2770)، والطبراني 23/ 50 (133) من طريق معمر به.

notes.en: In M: “and from.”
notes.ar: في م: "وعن".

notes.en: Omitted in the manuscripts; the adopted reading is from the author’s history.

notes.en: In T2: “ʿĀʾishah in her report.”

notes.en: Sīrat Ibn Hishām, 2/297–302. The author reports it in his Taʾrīkh, 2/611–612. Al-Ṭabarānī, 23/111 (no. 151), reports it through Abū Uways from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAmrah. He also reports it, 23/122 (no. 160), through Ibn Isḥāq from Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbbād.
notes.ar: سيرة ابن هشام 2/ 297 - 302، وأخرجه المصنف في تاريخه 2/ 611، 612، وأخرجه الطبراني 23/ 111 (151) من طريق أبي أويس عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر بن محمد عن عمرة به، وأخرجه أيضا 23/ 122 (160) من طريق ابن إسحاق عن يحيى بن عباد به.

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, T2, and F: “then”; the adopted reading agrees with the source collections.
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ف: "ثم"، والمثبت موافق لما في مصادر التخريج.

notes.en: That is, they accused her. Al-abn means accusation. Al-Nihāyah, 1/17.
notes.ar: أي: اتهموها، والأَبْنُ: التهمة. النهاية 1/ 17.

notes.en: Omitted in M, T1, and F.
notes.ar: سقط من: م، ت 1، ف.

notes.ar: في ص، م، ت 1، ف: "أغيب"، وتنظر مصادر التخريج.

notes.ar: في ت 2: "تري".

notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ف: "إلى".

notes.en: Baqaratu al-ḥadīth means “I opened it up and laid it bare”; some transmitters read naqqartu, “I investigated it.” Al-Nihāyah, 1/145 and 5/105.
notes.ar: بقرت الحديث، أي: فتحته وكشفته؛ ورواه بعضهم: "نقَّرت"، والتنقير: التفتيش. النهاية 1/ 145، 5/ 105.

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: Al-iktināf means enclosing something from both sides. Al-Nihāyah, 4/205.
notes.ar: الاكتناف: الإحاطة من الجانبين. النهاية 4/ 205.

notes.en: In T2: “I approached.” One says qārafa a sin or other matter when one draws near to it and is almost involved in it. Al-Nihāyah, 4/45.
notes.ar: في ت 2: قاربت، وقارف الذنب وغيره، إذا داناه ولاصقه. النهاية 4/ 45.

notes.en: In Ṣ and T2: “they will surely say.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 2: "ليقولن".

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, T2, and F: “so I may gain insight”; see the source references.
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ف: "لأستنير"، وتنظر مصادر التخريج.

notes.en: In T2: “a bar of gold.” Al-tibr is gold before it is struck into dinars and dirhams. Al-Nihāyah, 1/179.
notes.ar: في ت 2: "مبرد"، والتبر: الذهب قبل أن يضرب دنانير ودراهم. النهاية 1/ 179.

notes.en: Al-kanf means the side or direction. Al-Nihāyah, 4/205.
notes.ar: الكنف: الجانب والناحية. النهاية 4/ 205.

notes.en: Yastawshīhi means seeking out a report by investigating it. Al-Nihāyah, 5/190.
notes.ar: يستوشيه: يستخرج الحديث بالبحث عنه. النهاية 5/ 190.

notes.en: Aḥmad, 6/59 (al-Maymaniyyah edition), Muslim (no. 58/2770), al-Tirmidhī (no. 3180), and al-Ṭabarānī, 23/108 (no. 150), report it through Abū Usāmah; al-Bukhārī (no. 4757) cites it without a chain through Abū Usāmah. Al-Bukhārī (no. 7370), Abū Dāwūd (no. 5219), and al-Ṭabarānī, 23/106 (no. 149), report it through Hishām ibn ʿUrwah.
notes.ar: أخرجه أحمد 6/ 59 (الميمنية)، ومسلم (58/ 2770)، والترمذي (3180)، والطبراني 23/ 108 (150) من طريق أبي أسامة به، وعلقه البخاري (4757) عن أبي أسامة به، وأخرجه البخاري (7370)، وأبو داود (5219)، والطبراني 23/ 106 (149) من طريق هشام بن عروة به.

notes.en: Al-madhhab is the place where one defecates. Al-Nihāyah, 2/173.
notes.ar: المذهب: الموضع الذي يتغوط فيه. النهاية 2/ 173.

notes.en: One says “I struck him with a sword” when one hit him with it. Al-Nihāyah, 1/285.
notes.ar: يقال: جلدته بالسيف، إذا ضربته به. النهاية 1/ 285.

notes.en: In Ṣ and F: “thrusts.”
notes.ar: في ص، ف: "طعائن".

notes.en: Al-iḥnah means rancor; its plurals are iḥan and iḥanāt. Al-Nihāyah, 1/27.
notes.ar: الإحنة: الحقد، وجمعها إحَن وإحَنَات. النهاية 1/ 27.

notes.en: Al-ṣālib fever is the hot fever without chills; it is also said to involve intense heat. Lisān al-ʿArab, root ṣ-l-b.
notes.ar: الصالب من الحمى: الحارة غير النافض، وقيل: التي معها حر شديد .. اللسان (ص ل ب).

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: Al-qāl is a verbal noun meaning “speech.” The meaning is: “He found God’s decree”—that is, God’s word reached and came to pass for him.
notes.ar: القال مصدر بمعنى القول، والمراد وجد قال الله، أي: أدركه قول الله عز وجل وتحقق فيه.

notes.en: In T1: “he spends on Misṭaḥ without benefiting him.”
notes.ar: في ت 1: "ينفق على مسطح ولا ينفعه".

Al-Bukhārī (no. 4752) and al-Ṭabarānī, 23/143 (no. 201), report it through Ibn Abī Mulaykah. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/33, to Ibn al-Mundhir and Ibn Mardawayh.

notes.en: Al-Farrāʾ’s Maʿānī al-Qurʾān, 2/248. In Lisān al-ʿArab, root z-l-q, it is attributed to al-Qalākh ibn Ḥazn al-Minqārī; under root w-l-q, it is attributed to al-Shammākh.
notes.ar: معاني القرآن للفراء 2/ 248. ونسبه في اللسان (ز ل ق) إلى القلاخ بن حزن المنقرى، ونسبه في (و ل ق) إلى الشماخ.

notes.en: A rajul zaliq zamilaq is a man who ejaculates before intercourse; zamilaq also means light and rash. Lisān al-ʿArab, roots z-l-q and z-m-l-q.
notes.ar: رجل زلق زملق: هو الذي ينزل قبل أن يجامع. والزملق أيضا: الخفيف الطائش. اللسان (ز ل ق، زملق).

notes.en: In T2 and F: “ʿĪs.” Al-ʿans is a strong she-camel; al-ʿīs are white camels with a slight reddish tint. Lisān al-ʿArab, roots ʿ-n-s and ʿ-y-s.
notes.ar: في ت 2، ف: "عيس". والعنس: الناقة القوية. والعيس: الإبل البيض مع شقرة يسيرة. اللسان (ع ن س، ع ي س).

notes.en: Al-Farrāʾ’s Maʿānī al-Qurʾān, 2/248, and Lisān al-ʿArab, root w-l-q.

notes.en: Al-yalmaqu is a qabaʾ (outer coat), a Persian loanword. Lisān al-ʿArab, root y-l-m-q.
notes.ar: اليلمق: القباء، فارسي معرب. اللسان (يلمق).

notes.en: Al-idhhān means deception. Lisān al-ʿArab, root d-h-n.
notes.ar: الإدهان: الغش: اللسان (د هـ ن).

Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2548, reports it through Shibl from Ibn Abī Najīḥ. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/33, to Ibn Abī Shaybah, ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd, and Ibn al-Mundhir.

notes.ar: في ت 2: "مسلم بن عمير". ولم نجد لسالم بن عمر ترجمة، ولا يصح أن تكون العبارة: سالم عن ابن عمر. لأن ابن المبارك ولد سنة ثمان عشرة ومائة، وتوفى سالم سنة خمس ومائة. فالله أعلم. وينظر ما سيأتي في ص 322.

notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ت 3، ف: "عمار". وهو عمارة بن أبي حفصة، سيورد المصنف روايته في الأثر القادم. وينظر تهذيب الكمال 21/ 238.

notes.en: Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/54, to the author.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 54 إلى المصنف.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2618, reports it through Aṣbagh from Ibn Zayd, with the wording “the cloud’s folds.”
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2618 من طريق أصبغ، عن ابن زيد، بلفظ: الخلال السحاب.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2619, reports it through Ibn Jurayj. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/54, to Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2619 من طريق ابن جريج به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 54 إلى ابن المنذر.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/61–62; through him, Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2619. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/54, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd.
notes.ar: تفسير عبد الرزاق، 2/ 61،62، ومن طريقه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2619، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 54 إلى عبد بن حميد.

notes.en: In M: “light.”
notes.ar: في م: "ضوء".

notes.en: Al-Nashr, 2/249.
notes.ar: النشر 2/ 249.

notes.en: In M: “this.”
notes.ar: في م: "هذا".

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: This is the reading of Ḥamzah and al-Kisāʾī. Ḥujjat al-qirāʾāt, p. 502.
notes.ar: وهي قراءة حمزة والكسائي. حجة القراءات ص 502.

notes.en: This is the reading of Nāfiʿ, Ibn Kathīr, ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Abū ʿAmr. See the preceding source.
notes.ar: وهى قراءة نافع وابن كثير وعاصم وابن عامر وأبي عمرو. ينظر المصدر السابق.

notes.en: In M: “he intended.”
notes.ar: في م: "أراد".

notes.en: Al-Qurṭubī mentions it in his Tafsīr, 12/293.
notes.ar: ذكره القرطبي في تفسيره 12/ 293.

notes.en: Omitted in M.
notes.ar: سقط من: م.

notes.en: In M: “he feared.”
notes.ar: في م: "خاف".

notes.en: In M: “so it is decided.”
notes.ar: في م: "فيقضى".

notes.en: In M: “that they say.”
notes.ar: في م: "أن يقولوا".

notes.en: In M: “his command and prohibition.”
notes.ar: في م: "أمره ونهاه".

notes.en: The manuscripts read “to”; the adopted reading is from al-Durr al-manthūr.
notes.ar: في النسخ: "إلى". والمثبت من الدر المنثور.

notes.en: Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/54, to Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 54 إلى ابن المنذر.

notes.en: The manuscripts read “yourselves”; the adopted reading is required by the context.
notes.ar: في النسخ: "بأنفسكم". والمثبت ما يقتضيه السياق.

notes.en: In M, T1, T3, and F: “so you are destroyed.”
notes.ar: في م، ت 1، ت 3، ف: "فتوبقون".

notes.en: This is the reading of Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamzah, al-Kisāʾī, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim. Ibn Mujāhid’s al-Sabʿah, p. 458.
notes.ar: هي قراءة ابن كثير ونافع وأبى عمرو وحمزة والكسائي وابن عامر وحفص عن عاصم. السبعة لابن مجاهد ص 458.

notes.en: In the transmission of Abū Bakr. Same source.
notes.ar: في رواية أبي بكر. المصدر السابق.

notes.en: This is the reading of Ḥamzah, al-Kisāʾī, Ibn ʿĀmir, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim. Same source, pp. 458–459.
notes.ar: وبها قرأ حمزة والكسائي وابن عامر ونافع وأبو عمرو وحفص عن عاصم. المصدر السابق ص 458، 459.

notes.en: In the transmission of Abū Bakr; it is also the reading of Ibn Kathīr. Ibn Mujāhid’s al-Sabʿah, p. 459.
notes.ar: في رواية أبي بكر، وبها قرأ ابن كثير. السبعة لابن مجاهد ص 459.

notes.en: His Dīwān, p. 204.
notes.ar: ديوانه ص 204.

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, T2, and T3: “other than him.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ت 3: "غيره".

notes.en: In M, T1, T3, and F: “afraid.”
notes.ar: في م، ت 1، ت 3، ف: "خائفون".

notes.en: In Ṣ and F: “you are afflicted”; in T2: “they break their fast.” Taghburūn means “you remain”; al-ghābir is what remains. Lisān al-ʿArab, root gh-b-r.
notes.ar: في ص، ف: "تعترون"، وفى ت 2: "يفطرون". وتغبرون: تبقون، والغابر هو الباقي. اللسان (غ ب ر).

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2629–2630, reports it through Abū Jaʿfar. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/55, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd. Al-Ḥākim, 2/401, and al-Bayhaqī in al-Dalāʾil, 3/6–7, report it through al-Rabīʿ, from Abū al-ʿĀliyah, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2629، 2630 من طريق أبي جعفر به. وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 55 إلى عبد بن حميد، وأخرجه الحاكم 2/ 401، والبيهقي في الدلائل 3/ 6، 7 من طريق الربيع، عن أبي العالية، عن أبي بن كعب.

notes.en: The manuscripts read “ibn”; the adopted reading is from Ibn Abī Ḥātim’s Tafsīr. See Tahdhīb al-kamāl, 11/340.
notes.ar: في النسخ: "ابن". والمثبت من تفسير ابن أبي حاتم، وينظر تهذيب الكمال 11/ 340.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2627, reports it through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/55, to Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2627 من طريق عبد الرحمن به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 55 إلى ابن مردويه.

notes.en: Omitted in the manuscripts; the adopted reading is supported by the citation above at 8/743.
notes.ar: سقط من النسخ، والمثبت مما تقدم في 8/ 743.

notes.en: In T1 and F: “the verse.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ف: "الآية".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2630, reports it through al-Ḥajjāj.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2630 من طريق الحجاج به.

notes.en: Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/55, to al-Firyābī, Ibn Abī Shaybah, ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd, and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 55 إلى الفريابي وابن أبي شيبة وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر.

notes.en: This is the reading of Ḥamzah and Ibn ʿĀmir. Ibn Mujāhid’s al-Sabʿah, p. 307.
notes.ar: وهى قراءة حمزة وابن عامر. السبعة لابن مجاهد ص 307.

notes.en: Omitted in Ṣ and M; F reads: “with tāʾ.”
notes.ar: سقط من: ص، م، وفى ف: "بالتاء".

notes.en: In M: “its speaker.”
notes.ar: في م: "قائله".

notes.en: The reading with yāʾ is mass-transmitted; see its grammatical explanation in al-Kashshāf, 3/74, and al-Baḥr al-muḥīṭ, 6/471.
notes.ar: القراءة بالياء متواترة؛ وينظر توجيهها في الكشاف 3/ 74، والبحر المحيط 6/ 471.

notes.en: Al-Bukhārī in al-Adab al-mufrad (no. 1057) and al-Naḥḥās in al-Nāsikh wa-l-mansūkh, p. 593, report it through Layth. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/56, to Ibn Abī Shaybah and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه البخارى في الأدب المفرد (1057)، والنحاس في الناسخ والمنسوخ ص 593، من طريق ليث به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 56 إلى ابن أبي شيبة وابن المنذر.

notes.en: Abū ʿUbayd in al-Nāsikh, p. 313, and Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2633, report it through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Ibn Abī Shaybah, 4/400, and al-Naḥḥās in al-Nāsikh wa-l-mansūkh, p. 592, report it through Sufyān. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/56, to al-Firyābī, ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd, and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه أبو عبيد في الناسخ ص 313، وابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2633 من طريق عبد الرحمن به، وأخرجه ابن أبي شيبة 4/ 400، والنحاس في الناسخ والمنسوخ ص 592 من طريق سفيان به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 56 إلى الفريابي وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر.

notes.en: Abū ʿUbayd in al-Nāsikh, p. 312, reports it through Ḥajjāj; on p. 319 he reports it from Ibn Jurayj.
notes.ar: أخرجه أبو عبيد في الناسخ ص 312 من طريق حجاج به، وفى ص 319 عن ابن جريج به.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2634–2635, and al-Bayhaqī, 7/96, report it through Abū Ṣāliḥ. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/56, to Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2634، 2635، والبيهقى 7/ 96 من طريق أبي صالح به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 56 إلى ابن المنذر.

notes.en: The manuscripts read “from”; it will appear in the commentary on Qāf, verse 14. See Tahdhīb al-kamāl, 4/397.
notes.ar: في النسخ: "عن"، وسيأتي في تفسير الآية (14) من سورة "ق"، وينظر تهذيب الكمال 4/ 397.

notes.en: Al-Bukhārī in al-Adab al-mufrad (no. 1052) reports it through Ibn Shihāb. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr cites it without a chain in al-Tamhīd, 16/234, from Ibn Wahb. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/56, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه البخارى في الأدب المفرد (1052) من طريق ابن شهاب به، وعلقه ابن عبد البر في التمهيد 16/ 234 عن ابن وهب به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 56 إلى عبد بن حميد.

notes.en: The sourcing was given above, p. 244.
notes.ar: تقدم تخريجه في ص 244.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2633 and 2637, reports it through Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ. Abū ʿUbayd mentions it in al-Nāsikh, pp. 318–319, from al-Ḥasan.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2633، 2637 من طريق يزيد بن زريع به، وذكره أبو عبيد في الناسخ ص 318، 319 عن الحسن.

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, T2, and F: “ibn ʿĀʾishah.” See Tahdhīb al-kamāl, 29/90.
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ف: "بن عائشة". وينظر تهذيب الكمال 29/ 90.

notes.en: Abū ʿUbayd in al-Nāsikh, p. 315, reports it through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Ibn Abī Shaybah, 4/400; Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2633; al-Naḥḥās in his Nāsikh, p. 595; and Ibn al-Jawzī in al-Nawāsikh, pp. 410–411, all report it through Sufyān.
notes.ar: أخرجه أبو عبيد في الناسخ ص 315 عن عبد الرحمن به، وأخرجه ابن أبي شيبة 4/ 400، وابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2633، والنحاس في ناسخه ص 595، وابن الجوزى في النواسخ ص 410، 411، جميعهم من طريق سفيان به.

notes.en: Abū ʿUbayd in al-Nāsikh, p. 316, reports it from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Ibn al-Jawzī in al-Nawāsikh, p. 410, reports it through Abū ʿAwānah from Ibn ʿAbbās. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/56, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه أبو عبيد في الناسخ ص 316 عن عبد الرحمن به، وأخرجه ابن الجوزي في النواسخ ص 410 من طريق أبي عوانة به عن ابن عباس، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 56 إلى عبد بن حميد.

notes.en: Al-Naḥḥās in his Nāsikh, pp. 591–592, reports it through Muḥammad ibn Bashshār.
notes.ar: أخرجه النحاس في ناسخه ص 591، 592 من طريق محمد بن بشار به.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Shaybah, 4/400, and Ibn Abī Ḥātim, 8/2636, report it through Ḥanẓalah.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي شيبة 4/ 400، وابن أبي حاتم 8/ 2636 من طريق حنظلة به.

notes.en: Al-Bazzār (no. 1055) reports it from Muḥammad ibn al-Muthannā. Abū Yaʿlā (no. 868) reports it through ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar. Ibn Abī Shaybah, 2/439, and al-Bayhaqī, 1/372, report it through ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Abī Rawwād. ʿAbd al-Razzāq in his Muṣannaf (no. 2153) reports it through Tamīm ibn Ghaylān. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/57, to Ibn Abī Ḥātim and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه البزار (1055) عن محمد بن المثنى به، وأخرجه أبو يعلى (868) من طريق عثمان بن عمر به، وأخرجه ابن أبي شيبة 2/ 439، والبيهقى 1/ 372 من طريق عبد العزيز بن أبى رواد به، وعبد الرزاق في المصنف (2153) من طريق تميم بن غيلان به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 57 إلى ابن أبي حاتم وابن المنذر.

notes.en: This is the reading of Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim. Ibn Mujāhid’s al-Sabʿah, p. 459.
notes.ar: هي قراءة ابن كثير ونافع وأبي عمرو وابن عامر وحفص عن عاصم. السبعة لابن مجاهد ص 459.

notes.en: This is the reading of Ḥamzah, al-Kisāʾī, and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim. Same source.
notes.ar: هي قراءة حمزة والكسائي وأبى بكر عن عاصم. المصدر السابق.

notes.en: In Ṣ, T2, and F: “He will admit them.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 2، ف: "يدخلهم".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2636. This completes the narration cited above, p. 353.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2636، وهو تتمة الأثر المتقدم في ص 353.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2637, reports it through Abū Ṣāliḥ. Its beginning was cited above, pp. 353 and 357.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2637 من طريق أبي صالح به، وتقدم أوله في ص 353، 357.

notes.en: Al-Qurṭubī mentions it in his Tafsīr, 12/308, from Ibn Jurayj from ʿAṭāʾ.
notes.ar: ذكره القرطبي في تفسيره 12/ 308 عن ابن جريج، عن عطاء.

notes.en: Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr in al-Tamhīd, 16/233, reports it through Ibn Wahb. Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2638, reports it through Yūnus ibn Yazīd from Ibn Shihāb.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن عبد البر في التمهيد 16/ 233 من طريق ابن وهب به، وأخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2638 من طريق يونس بن يزيد عن ابن شهاب به.

notes.en: Ṣ, M, T1, T3, and F add after it: “His signs.”
notes.ar: بعده في ص، م، ت 1، ت 3، ف: "آياته".

notes.en: In T1: “the relatives.”
notes.ar: في ت 1: "القرباء".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2641, and al-Bayhaqī, 7/93, report it through Abū Ṣāliḥ. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr, 5/57, to Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2641، والبيهقى 7/ 93 من طريق أبي صالح به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر 5/ 57 إلى ابن المنذر.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2639, reports it through Abū Muʿādh, but without the phrase “meaning the jilbāb, the face veil.”
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2639 من طريق أبي معاذ به، دون قوله: يعنى الجلباب، وهو القناع.

notes.en: In T2: “a Sunnah.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "سنية".

notes.en: In M: “Muzaynah”; in T1, T2, and T3: “Muzaynah.”
notes.ar: في م: "مزنية"، وفى ت 1، ت 2، ت 3: "مزينة".

notes.en: In T1, T2, and T3: “those who have.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ت 2، ت 3: "اللاتي قد".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim, 8/2640, reports it through Ḥajjāj, giving only the phrase “they do not display them.” Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/57, to Ibn al-Mundhir. The phrase “their jilbābs” occurs in Mujāhid’s Tafsīr, p. 494; it will appear below, p. 364.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم 8/ 2640 من طريق حجاج به مقتصرًا على قوله: لا يردنه. وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 57 إلى ابن المنذر. وقوله: جلابيبهن. في تفسير مجاهد ص 494. وسيأتي في ص 364.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2640, reports it through Aṣbagh from Ibn Zayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2640 من طريق أصبغ، عن ابن زيد.

notes.en: The manuscripts read: “dhar.”
notes.ar: في النسخ: "ذر".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2640, reports it through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān alone. ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/63, and al-Ṭabarānī (no. 9022) report it through Sufyān.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2640 من طريق عبد الرحمن وحده به، وأخرجه عبد الرزاق في تفسيره 2/ 63، والطبراني (9022) من طريق سفيان به.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2640, and al-Bayhaqī, 7/93, report it through Shuʿbah.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2640، والبيهقى 7/ 93 من طريق شعبة به.

notes.en: Omitted in Ṣ, M, and F.
notes.ar: سقط من: ص، م، ف.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/63; through him, Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2640.
notes.ar: تفسير عبد الرزاق 2/ 63، ومن طريقه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2640.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/63.
notes.ar: تفسير عبد الرزاق 2/ 63.

notes.en: In Ṣ and T1: “he said.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1: "قال".

notes.en: Omitted in T1 and F.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/653, reports it from Muḥammad ibn Saʿd. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/60, to Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 653 عن محمد بن سعد به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 60 إلى ابن المنذر.

notes.en: In T2: “ibn Bukayr.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "بن بكير".

notes.en: In T2: “Friday.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "الجمعة".

notes.en: Omitted in Ṣ, M, T1, and F.
notes.ar: سقط من: ص، م، ت 1، ف.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq in his Muṣannaf, 3/242, and Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2653 (no. 14918), report it through Ibn Jurayj. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/60, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه عبد الرزاق في مصنفه 3/ 242 وابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2653 (14918) من طريق ابن جريج، به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 60 إلى عبد بن حميد.

notes.en: That is, “are you deceiving people with it?” Al-daghal means corruption; it is also said to derive from “I inserted into this matter,” meaning that one introduced something into it that contradicts and corrupts it. Al-Nihāyah, 2/123.
notes.ar: أي: أتخدع به الناس، والدغل: الفساد، وقيل هو من قولهم: أدخلت في هذا الأمر. إذا أدخلت فيه ما يخالفه ويفسده. النهاية 2/ 123.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/66, and his Muṣannaf, 3/243.
notes.ar: تفسير عبد الرزاق 2/ 66، ومصنفه 3/ 243.

notes.en: T2 adds after it: “except.”
notes.ar: بعده في ت 2: "إلا".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2654, reports it through Aṣbagh from Ibn Zayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2654 من طريق أصبغ، عن ابن زيد.

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: In T2: “they ask your permission.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "استأذنوك".

notes.en: In T2: “he says.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "يقول".

notes.en: In T1 and T2: “for him.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ت 2: "له".

notes.en: In T1: “by that.”
notes.ar: في ت 1: "بذلك".

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2655, reports it from Muḥammad ibn Saʿd. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/61, to Ibn Mardawayh.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2655 عن محمد بن سعد به، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 61 إلى ابن مردويه.

notes.en: In T2: “with what is severe.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "بما يغلظ".

notes.en: Mujāhid’s Tafsīr, p. 495; through him, Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2655. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/61, to Ibn Abī Shaybah, ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd, and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: تفسير مجاهد ص 495 ومن طريقه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2655، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 61 إلى ابن أبي شيبة وعبد بن حميد وابن المنذر.

notes.en: ʿAbd al-Razzāq’s Tafsīr, 2/66. Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2655, reports it through Saʿīd from Qatādah. Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/61, to ʿAbd ibn Ḥumayd and Ibn al-Mundhir.
notes.ar: تفسير عبد الرزاق 2/ 66، وأخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2655 من طريق سعيد، عن قتادة، وعزاه السيوطي في الدر 5/ 61 إلى عبد بن حميد وابن المنذر.

notes.en: In M: “without his permission from him.”
notes.ar: في م: "بغير إذنه عنه".

notes.en: In Ṣ and T2: “briefly”; in T1: “secretly.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 2: "يسيرا"، وفي ت 1: "سرا".

notes.en: T1 adds after it: “God.”
notes.ar: بعده في ت 1: "الله".

notes.en: Omitted in T2.
notes.ar: سقط من: ت 2.

notes.en: In T2: “he used to whisper.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "كان يسر".

notes.en: In M and T1: “he feels secure.”
notes.ar: في م، ت 1: "يأمن".

notes.en: In T1, T2, and F: “so he strikes.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ت 2، ف: "فيضرب".

notes.en: Al-Suyūṭī attributed it in al-Durr al-manthūr, 5/62, to Abū al-Shaykh.
notes.ar: عزاه السيوطي في الدر المنثور 5/ 62 إلى أبى الشيخ.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2656, reports it through Ḥajjāj. It is in Mujāhid’s Tafsīr, p. 495, as a statement of Mujāhid.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2656 من طريق حجاج به، وهو في تفسير مجاهد ص 495 من قول مجاهد.

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2657, reports it through Aṣbagh from Ibn Zayd, omitting its conclusion, which he cites without a chain.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2657 من طريق أصبغ، عن ابن زيد، دون آخره، فقد ذكره معلقا.

notes.en: In T1 and T2: “pleasurably.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ت 2: "لذاذا".

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, and T2: “his action.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2: "صنيعه".

notes.en: In Ṣ, T1, T2, and F: “its opposite.”
notes.ar: في ص، ت 1، ت 2، ف: "خلافه".

notes.en: In T2: “they turn away.”
notes.ar: في ت 2: "يولون".

notes.en: Omitted in M, T1, and F.
notes.ar: سقط من: م، ت 1، ت، ف.

notes.en: Omitted in M, T1, T2, T3, and F.
notes.ar: سقط من: م، ت 1، ت 2، ت 3، ف.

notes.en: M adds after it: “also.”
notes.ar: بعده في م: "أيضًا".

notes.en: Ibn Abī Ḥātim in his Tafsīr, 8/2658, reports it through Aṣbagh from Ibn Zayd.
notes.ar: أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم في تفسيره 8/ 2658 من طريق أصبغ، عن ابن زيد.

notes.en: In T1, T2, and F: “you know it.”
notes.ar: في ت 1، ت 2، ف: "علمتموه".
